Title: paint in the memory of other programs
Migrating from GitHub to Codeberg
Description:
I created my GitHub account back in May 2009, and like most developers much of
my work since then has taken place on GitHub; both private and public work. In
August 2015 I joined GitLab, and in the years followed I primarily used GitLab
for my own work as well as for Inko. Part of this was
because at the time GitHub was neglecting its product, and because I wanted to
eat my own dog food so to speak.

Title: Memory management in 40 major C projects, a survey - The Consensus
Description: A survey of 40 major C projects tracked by The Consensus shows only 8 projects allocate solely with malloc/free, only 2 projects allocate without ever using malloc/free, 15 projects make use of regions at some point, 7 projects primarily use regions to allocate, 5 primarily use garbage collection to allocate, and 3 primarily use reference counting to allocate.

Title: A datetime library for Rust
Description:
Jiff is a datetime library for Rust that encourages you to jump into the
pit of success. Jiff automatically handles many common problems related to
daylight saving time by putting time zone handling front and center into the
API. Jiff has already seen widespread adoption in the Rust ecosystem.
